name: monobank
title: monobank
description: View currency rates, all your accounts and their transactions in monobank, set monthly budgets per category, see your subscriptions, keep a rate, a jar or your next subscription charge in the menu bar, and ask AI about them. Unofficial, not affiliated with mono.
author: danulqua

commands.name: convert
commands.title: Convert Currency
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Convert an amount at monobank's rates, e.g. Convert 100 USD.

commands.name: statement
commands.title: Show Statement
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Transactions of your monobank accounts and jars.

commands.name: budgets
commands.title: Show Budgets
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Monthly spending limits per category for your monobank accounts.

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.title: Show Subscriptions
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Recurring charges on your monobank cards, with their amount and next expected date.

commands.name: sync-statements
commands.title: Sync Statements
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Keeps the statements of all your accounts and jars up to date in the background: the last 31 days are refreshed daily, and older history is loaded up to "Keep Statements For", one request every 2 minutes.

commands.name: rates-menu-bar
commands.title: Currency Rate Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: A monobank currency rate in the menu bar, with the other rates in its menu.

preferences.name: rateTitle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: Which rate is shown next to the flag. Pairs with only a cross rate always show it.

preferences.name: showRateChange
preferences.title: Change in Title
preferences.label: Show change since yesterday
preferences.description: Add how much the rate in the title changed since the previous day, e.g. ↑0.12. The menu always shows it.

commands.name: jar-menu-bar
commands.title: Jar Progress Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: A monobank jar's progress in the menu bar, with your other jars in its menu.

preferences.name: jarTitle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What is shown next to the progress icon. Jars without a goal show their balance.

commands.name: subscriptions-menu-bar
commands.title: Subscriptions Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: monobank
commands.description: Your next monobank subscription charge in the menu bar, with all your subscriptions in its menu.

preferences.name: subscriptionsTitle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What is shown next to the icon.

tools.name: get-accounts
tools.title: Get Accounts
tools.description: Get the user's monobank accounts and jars: names, balances, own funds, credit limits, jar goals and progress, and top-up links.

tools.name: get-currency-rates
tools.title: Get Currency Rates
tools.description: Get monobank's current currency exchange rates (buy, sell and cross rates).

tools.name: convert-currency
tools.title: Convert Currency
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies at monobank's current rates.

tools.name: get-transactions
tools.title: Get Transactions
tools.description: Get the transactions of a monobank account or jar for a period, with income, spending and per-category totals. A period can be up to 31 days, or longer when the stored history covers it.

tools.name: get-budgets
tools.title: Get Budgets
tools.description: Get the user's monthly budgets per spending category and how much of each is spent and left this or last month.

tools.name: set-budget
tools.title: Set Budget
tools.description: Create a monthly budget (a spending limit in UAH for some categories) or change an existing one, after the user confirms.

tools.name: delete-budget
tools.title: Delete Budget
tools.description: Delete one of the user's monthly budgets, after the user confirms.

tools.name: get-subscriptions
tools.title: Get Subscriptions
tools.description: Get the user's subscriptions and other recurring charges on their monobank cards, with the amount, cadence and next expected date of each, found in the stored statement history.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Your monobank Access Token. Required for the "Show Accounts", "Show Statement", "Show Budgets", "Show Subscriptions", "Sync Statements", "Jar Progress Menu Bar" and "Subscriptions Menu Bar" commands and for AI questions about your accounts, transactions, budgets and subscriptions.

preferences.name: statementRetention
preferences.title: Keep Statements For
preferences.description: How long transactions stay stored on this device. "Sync Statements" loads history up to this length (a year for Unlimited). Older ones are deleted the next time a statement is read. Unlimited never deletes them, so storage keeps growing.

preferences.name: fullName
preferences.title: Full Name for Requisites
preferences.description: Your full name for "Copy Requisites" in "Show Accounts". Overrides the name from monobank, which has no patronymic.

preferences.name: taxId
preferences.title: Tax ID (РНОКПП)
preferences.description: Your tax ID for "Copy Requisites" in "Show Accounts". Left out when empty.

echo "

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
